name: ferryvn
description: Search Vietnam high-speed ferry voyages, seat maps, customers and bookings on FerryVN; booking writes are opt-in.
long_description: Official FerryVN MCP server. Read tools: locations, routes, voyages, voyage calendar, seat maps with prices and age-based ticket types, customers, bookings, cancellation requests, disruptions, account balance, vouchers. Optional write tools (create customer, create booking, request cancellation) always ask you to confirm. Payments and ticket issuance are never exposed.

api_key.title: FerryVN API key
api_key.description: Partner API key from the FerryVN dashboard (Settings → API keys).

enable_writes.title: Allow creating customers, bookings and cancellation requests
enable_writes.description: Off by default. Every write still asks for your confirmation; payments and ticket issuance are never available.

tools.name: search_voyages
tools.description: Voyages between two locations on a date

tools.name: get_route_prices
tools.description: Selling prices of a route per voyage, seat type and ticket type

tools.name: get_seat_map
tools.description: Free seats by seat type, prices, harbor fee and ticket types

tools.name: quote_booking
tools.description: Validate and price a booking without creating it

tools.name: get_booking
tools.description: One booking with orders and tickets

prompts.name: plan_ferry_trip
prompts.text: Plan a ferry trip from ${arguments.from} to ${arguments.to} on ${arguments.date} for ${arguments.passengers}.
